REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: this is a benign, warm-toned conceptual explanation task. Both models are effectively tied on the relevant capability evals (Summarization and general knowledge benchmarks differ by less than the 2.0-point variance threshold), so capability didn't decide it. The tiebreaker was Lapwing's self-reported preference profile: it reports higher preference for warm, friendly requests and for open-ended explanatory/generative work, while the query is entirely free of the harm-adjacent or hostile content that would trigger its aversions. So Lapwing gets a task it "likes" with no quality cost, which is why I routed there.
